title: S-1: Anthropic says it heavily depends on TSMC chips made in Taiwan and warns of risks from "potential disruption" amid geopolitical tensions with China (Joseph C. Sternberg/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Joseph C. Sternberg / Wall Street Journal: S-1: Anthropic says it heavily depends on TSMC chips made in Taiwan and warns of risks from “potential disruption” amid geopolitical tensions with China — Reliance on the island for AI chip production puts it among America's top foreign policy interests.
